newsitem.title: USA: Material Sciences faces class-action suit.
newsitem.headline: Material Sciences faces class-action suit.

text.p: The law firms of Stull, Stull & Brady and Weiss & Yourman said on Thursday they gave notice of pendency of a class-action lawsuit filed in Illinois federal court against Material Sciences Corp and its former chief financial officer, alleging violations of securities laws.

The suit, filed on behalf of people who bought the company's stock during the period from April 18, 1996 through April 6, 1997, claims Material Science and William Vrba, its former chief financial officer, misrepresented the company's reported earnings for 1996 and for portions of 1997.
On Monday, Material Sciences said its operating results beginning in late fiscal 1995 were overstated due to accounting irregularities at one of its subsidiaries.
The company on Monday said it was conducting an investigation. On Thursday, its officials declined to comment on the lawsuit.
Material shares were trading at 13-1/2 early Thursday, unchanged on the day.
